feeds.title: Woodcarving Illustrated Magazine Blog
feeds.description: The world's best how-to magazine for woodcarvers. Includes patterns, techniques, tips, and projects for all skill levels.

feeds.title: WoodBeeCarver
feeds.description: The Wood Bee Carver, Donald K. Mertz of Wilmington, Ohio has been actively carving since 1975 when he joined the National Wood Carvers Association.

feeds.title: David Fisher Carving Explorations
feeds.description: Welcome. I hope that this website may have something to offer you, whether you are interested in making some things yourself, learning about the process, or purchasing something that I have made.

feeds.title: South Dakota Woodcarvers
feeds.description: South Dakota Woodcarvers, Inc. is a non-profit organization incorporated in the State of South Dakota for the purpose of preserving and expanding the fine art of woodcarving.

feeds.title: Carving Junkies
feeds.description: Covers tutorials that feature lot of progress photos from all angles and easy-to-follow instructions to get great results, free patterns, painting guides, and helpful articles with tips and techniques. Carving Junkies is trying to make wood carving addictively fun for as many people as possible.

feeds.title: Eric Goodson Woodcarving Notes
feeds.description: A novice's notebook on greenwood carving and treenware.

feeds.title: Beginners Carving Corner & Beyond
feeds.description: Beginners Carving Corner and Beyond was started by Thomas Perrin and Tom Hindes. After several years of blog authoring, Thomas Perrin passed away, and Tom Hindes decided to continue the blog as Thomas Perrin would have wanted. Thomas Perrin was a wood carver, and a true and helpful friend to anyone interested in wood carving. His willingness to help was his hallmark.

feeds.title: Carvings by George
feeds.description: I'm Randy George, a woodcarver. I started this page to share my work, along with tips and techniques.

feeds.title: Tributes In Wood
feeds.description: Wood Carvings by Mark Sheridan. I've been carving since I was a boy and completed a few pieces over the years when the kids were growing up and I was early in my career. My recent carvings have mostly been caricature carvings although I've also completed a couple of bark carvings.

feeds.title: Ales
feeds.description: I started carving in late autumn of 2010, the year I moved to Canada. The whole idea was caused by a simple warning from my girlfriend that winters in PEI are boring. I am always happy to take a part in carving at various shows and events to promote both my work and wood carving as a hobby.

feeds.title: The World Of Carvings With Stories
feeds.description: A blog by a Bristol UK based woodcarver, with current woodcarving and other projects that I'm involved in, my courses and youth work, and lots more.

feeds.title: The Joy of Wood
feeds.description: A multi-skilled person, my diverse working life has two common threads running through it a passion for working with people, and a passion for working with wood. Since January 2009, I have returned to the making of custom furniture and joinery and my passion for teaching traditional hand skills.

feeds.title: Barn the Spoon Blog
feeds.description: The barn has been woodwork obsessive for over 20 years. 8 years ago he decided spoons were his thing and dedicated his life to them.

feeds.title: Nic Westermann
feeds.description: Nic set up his forge 18 years ago making decorative ironwork. Blacksmith Nic Westermann forged wood carving tools, ie axes, gouges, knives. adzes, drawknives etc

feeds.title: Spoon Carving First Steps
feeds.description: Jon Mac is an accomplished spoon carver who works with three spoon carving tools. JonMac MiniMac knife-spoonknife-Axe.

feeds.title: Ninth Wave Designs » Wood Carving
feeds.description: Welcome to the Ninth Wave Designs website featuring the wood carvings and paintings of Lisa Laughy.

feeds.title: Carver Dale
feeds.description: My name is Dale Kirkpatrick. I've lived in the Pittsburgh area since 1967. I've considered woodcarving my hobby for over 35 years. I've taken many classes to study realistic human and caricature subjects. I'm a member of The National Woodcarvers Association, Chisels and Chips.

feeds.title: William Rush Woodcarvers Club
feeds.description: The William Rush Woodcarving Club, a chapter of the National Woodcarving Association, was organized in January 1977 be a small group of people interested in wood carving. It has grown to approimately eighty whittlers and carvers in Southeastern Pennsylvania, Including Philadelphia.

feeds.title: Sean Hellman
feeds.description: Sean Hellman green woodwork blog on carving fan birds, kuksa carving, pole lathe turning, spoon carving and other aspects of traditional wood work. Tuition in woodwork in Devon and tools for sale.

feeds.title: Bird Carvings Tales Blog
feeds.description: Janice has been a bird carver since 2002. She carves basswood with knives and tupelo with power tools. Her favorite is which ever wood she has in her hands at the moment.

feeds.title: The Old Stump
feeds.description: My goal with this blog is to share my ideas, insights, and personal carving adventures with you. I hope that your visits here will be interesting, enlightening and maybe a little entertaining. Now get those tools sharp and let make some chips.

feeds.title: Woodcarvers of Las Vegas
feeds.description: We are a new group of woodcarvers of all skill levels who want to advance our skills and help others.

feeds.title: Woodcarving with Dan
feeds.description: Woodcarving courses run by Dan Bendel with pictures of students work in progress, past and present Commissions made by Dan and Pictures of ongoing art projects by Dan.

feeds.title: Will Worsnopp Wood Carving.
feeds.description: Experience the journey of an idea to a wood carving.

feeds.title: Folk Art Mary
feeds.description: Mary Michael Shelley writes about how she creates her carved and painted American Folk Art pictures of diners, farms and Americana themes.

feeds.title: Robin Wood Blog
feeds.description: Robin Wood is a master woodturner handcrafting beautiful wooden bowls and plates and carving wooden spoons.

feeds.title: Tharp Carving Studio Blog
feeds.description: This 4-session course will teach students the basics of woodcarving. By carving a simple relief design, students learn tool use, tool sharpening, and skills needed to carve more complex projects of their own.

feeds.title: Woodworkers Institute » Woodcarving
feeds.description: The Woodworkers Institute brings you latest news and equipment tests, projects and techniques plus blogs and an active community of woodworkers all from the home of the UKs best Woodworking magazines

feeds.title: My Chip Carving Blog
feeds.description: Chip carving instruction is provided with monthly online video lessons. Monthly patterns are provided as is a monthly E-letter, full of inspiration and encouragement to keep you moving forward with your chip carving.
